description: MCP server that ranks log patterns by volume and cost and plans an action for the excess over each cap: compact on Splunk and self-managed Elasticsearch, tier down or offload to S3 on other platforms. Runs locally over stdio.
rules: Install with npx -y log10x-mcp@latest; the server runs locally over stdio.
For a cost POC on local log files call log10x_poc_from_local; it needs the tenx binary on PATH or Docker.
Without LOG10X_API_KEY the server answers read-only from a public demo dataset.
Compact applies only to Splunk and self-managed Elasticsearch; on other platforms the actions are tier down and offload.

The Elasticsearch, Azure Monitor and GCP Cloud Logging connectors need their SDK added at start, for example npx -y -p log10x-mcp -p @elastic/elasticsearch log10x-mcp; a connector without it names the packages to add.
